acceptance_criteria.description: whitepaper.md exists and contains >= 8,000 words (or 20 markdown pages equivalent)
docs/release_manifest.json hashes match all files created
acceptance_criteria.verification: Run scripts/generate_whitepaper_release.sh and verify SHA256 hashes

acceptance_criteria.description: docs/appendix/property_tests.md documents commands to run property tests with expected sample output
docs/appendix/replay_cli.md contains exact CLI usage and example diff output
All P0 gaps (HSM, multi-region, FedNow/ACH, PCI) are listed in docs/p0_gaps.md with remediation and cost estimates

docs/appendix/invariants_formal.md contains LaTeX-style math blocks for I1-I5

docs/roadmap_budget.csv contains 40-week, $2.34M roadmap with line items
docs/appendix/example_test_output.txt shows expected go test output
docs/appendix/replay_digest_sample.txt contains sample digest with command
Commit references (7e4db6a, dfb54ad, 0236779, 000f41d, 0c50dc9) appear in whitepaper

reviewer_checklist.item: docs/whitepaper.md reads end-to-end and references code artifacts/commits
Formal invariants are precisely stated and correspond to existing property tests
Replay CLI usage reproduces sample digest output format
Audit bundle example verifies with sample public key included in docs
docs/p0_gaps.md enumerates P0s with remediation and budget
